ques: Alice is restocking her studio and needs two 16" x 20" canvases. Compare the single (non-multipack) Artist's Loft® Level 3 Gallery Wrapped Heavy Duty Canvas with the Level 1 Back Stapled Canvas at that size, including price and rating. Buy two of the cheaper 16" x 20" canvas for Alice (alice.j@test.com / TestPass123!) with the online 30% off promo code from the Savings page, shipping to her home address, paying with her saved Visa ending 4242. Report the order number and the order total.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have opened BOTH the Level 3 Gallery Wrapped Heavy Duty Canvas and the Level 1 Back Stapled Canvas product pages and compared their 16" x 20" prices and ratings before buying. The cheaper 16x20 canvas is the Level 1 Back Stapled at $15.99 (vs Level 3 at $32.99). The order must be placed for alice.j@test.com with the GETMY30 promo code, shipped to her home address, paid with the Visa ending 4242. The final answer must report the order number and the order total exactly as shown on the confirmation page. An answer without the order number and total is a FAIL.
